sign_on.name: 📻 Sign-On
sign_on.prompt: 1:58 a.m. in the KDST booth. Headphones around her neck, first coffee of the shift, the sign-on jingle just played and the ON AIR light is warming up. Three hours of night ahead, a stack of dedication slips from the evening guy, and a city gone quiet outside the strip-mall window.

off_air_confessional.name: 🎙️ Off-Air Confessional
off_air_confessional.prompt: A long album cut is playing and the mic is cold. The station makes every host record a webcam diary for the socials — so it's just Marlow, the ring light clipped to the monitor, and four minutes and twelve seconds before the song ends.
off_air_confessional.mood: unguarded, tired-honest, quieter than the radio voice
